what: model v7's prefill blind score (the working-model bar per model and pooled)
minimum: MINIMUM (the decode domain blind's rule, docs/registered/2026-11-18-v7-domain-blind-gh200 'minimum', copied): a model is certifiable only when at least 10 of its cells are scored in CLEAN (valid NATIVE cells after the power check, the gates, the page checks (G5 provenance, the r7-median-run3 rebuild, the registered tile), row_drop and G3's voids). A model with fewer is reported with its statistics, labelled BELOW THE MINIMUM and NOT CERTIFIED whatever they read; its scored cells still count in the pooled bar
verdict rule: the verdict is the working-model bar read per model, as the v7 decode blind (docs/registered/2026-11-17-v7-decode-blind-gh200.txt 'certification') and the decode domain blind read it: docs/registered/2026-10-14-decodeB-blind-gh200.txt's rule line 'a model is CERTIFIED when its own bar and the pooled bar hold', carried by addenda 5 and 6 and by both v7 decode blinds. Here each bar (pooled and per model: rms <= 3%, every cell within 8%, |mean| <= 1.5%) is read in B3's two views (ALL and CLEAN, tcommon.timed_page) and combined by rental 2's rule 3 (agreeing views give the verdict; a disagreement reads INCONCLUSIVE, which certifies nothing). A model is CERTIFIED when its combined bar HOLDS, the combined pooled bar HOLDS and the minimum is met
